title: Show purchase order delivery exceptions
description: Add a development-only read-only delivery-exception workspace using existing purchase-order requested/confirmed dates and approved stock-in records. Derive operational urgency from an explicit as-of date and receipt quantities without rewriting stored progress. Missing dates or incomplete evidence remain unknown. Do not execute migration, production SQL, real database operations or deployment.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded authenticated GET query filters purchase orders by supplier and as-of date and reports requested, supplier-confirmed and actual receipt evidence with stable paging.
Overdue, due-soon, late-confirmation and received states use approved nondeleted stock-ins only; partial receipts remain open and missing dates are shown as unknown.
The purchase-order page opens a read-only exception workspace with filters, status and quantity evidence; queries batch related rows instead of per-order database calls.
Focused unit tests cover date boundaries, partial receipt, deleted/unapproved rows, unknown values and no-write semantics; the safe Release build passes and the rules are documented.
